ops.text: Since the retention ratio is the same at every length, this relative saving does not grow with the context; Liu et al. (2026) estimate that a fixed 25% budget over-provisions 1M-token inputs roughly sevenfold, so a ratio that shrinks with length could compress the cache of Distance-KV further.
